contexts: The back cover separates the poetry from its musical settings and performances. It credits Cheo Zorrilla with both the music and performance of «Amor tardío»; Anthony Ríos with those roles on «Rosa silvestre»; and R. Bello with the music of «El pasado», sung by Omar Franco. It also documents «Amistad», composed by Anthony Ríos and sung by Lope Balaguer, and «Amor romántico», with music by Cheo Zorrilla and a performance by Gina D’Alessandro.
